plain: To take up and openly support an idea or cause

more.text: To embrace; to take to one's self, with a view to maintain; as, to espouse the quarrel of another; to espouse a cause.

example.quote: This, at best, is but a precarious security; because a power independent of the society may as well espouse the unjust views of the major, as the rightful interests of the minor party, and may possibly be turned against both parties.
